Title: AT&T powered guardian device with Azure Sphere is now available

Body.Content:
AT&T is a global leader and expert in network security and is deeply invested in providing the best security to their customers. AT&T provides the front-end security, including wireless network security, professional services, and support. Azure Sphere provides the back-end security, protecting the device or equipment connected to the guardian module. The new, cellular-enabled guardian module shows how Microsoft is empowering customers to achieve more, and in turn, to deliver innovation and opportunity to their customers. Check out the full announcement blog post to see the opportunities created.

Learn more.
